# Support Solum

Solum is maintained in the open. Before opening a new issue:

1. Search existing [issues](https://github.com/mateirenn/solum/issues) and [discussions](https://github.com/mateirenn/solum/discussions).
2. Use Discussions for questions, workflow ideas, and general feedback.
3. Use an issue for a reproducible bug or a scoped feature proposal.
4. Use the [security policy](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerability reports. Do not disclose security issues in a public issue.

When reporting a bug, include the Solum version, Windows version, project dimensions, reproduction steps, and any relevant logs or exported manifests. Please remove private project data before attaching files.
